FREELANCE GUIDE AGREEMENT between Gjergji Guide Services ("Guide") and Teuta Travel sh.p.k. ("Agency").
1. Services. The Guide leads Agency day tours in Kruja and Berat on dates agreed by message, at EUR 70 per tour day.
2. Payment. The Agency pays each month's tours by bank transfer within 30 days of the Guide's invoice.
3. Cancellation by the Agency. The Agency may cancel a tour day free of charge up to 5 days before the tour. Later cancellations are paid at 50%.
